# Vendored OpenMapTiles sources

`vendor/openmaptiles/` is a pristine mirror of a specific commit of the
[OpenMapTiles repository](https://github.com/openmaptiles/openmaptiles).
Upstream `master` is the source of truth for these files. The mirror is
generated by [`scripts/sync-upstream.js`](../scripts/sync-upstream.js) and is
replaced in full by the next sync, so do not rely on edits in place — reapply
local changes after a sync.

## Mirrored paths

Only these paths are copied from upstream:

- `LICENSE.md`
- `layers/`
- `openmaptiles.yaml`
- `style/`

Every other file and directory in the upstream repository is ignored.

## Lock file

[`openmaptiles.lock.json`](openmaptiles.lock.json) records the upstream
repository URL, ref, commit SHA, sync time, OpenMapTiles tools version (`7.2`),
mirrored paths, file count and a deterministic `sha256:` manifest hash. The
manifest hash covers the sorted relative paths and file bytes, so it is stable
across checkouts and platforms.

## Commands

```bash
npm run upstream:sync    # resolve master, download it and replace the mirror
npm run upstream:verify  # offline: recompute the manifest and compare it to the lock
npm run upstream:check   # network: fetch the latest master SHA and compare it to the lock
```

When GitHub API resolution is unavailable or rate-limited, sync a known commit
directly:

```bash
node scripts/sync-upstream.js --sync --ref <commit-sha>
```

CI should use `upstream:verify`, which never touches the network.
`upstream:check` is for manual or scheduled use and exits non-zero when
upstream `master` has moved past the locked commit.

## Licence

Per upstream `LICENSE.md`, the style code is BSD-3-Clause and the design and
cartography are CC-BY-4.0. Keep the OpenMapTiles and OpenStreetMap attribution
when reusing the sources.

## Build

Syncing updates the source tree only. It does not rebuild or republish the map
style. The published `style.json`, sprites, icons and fonts change only when
`./scripts/build.sh` runs. See [the build documentation](../docs/2.build.md).
